Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehcile collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with
that mechanism. Over the course of 27 visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory, includnig conservative management with
manual therapy, targeted stretching, and home exercise instruction. Vsiit frequency naturally decreased as symptoms improved
and function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain consistent with the reported
injury. The patient reports no prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding musculature, and no earlier treatment for this
region is known to this office. Billed services correspond to the documented care delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges
identified. Patient was discharged with instructions to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recur.
